citizen.name: Caspian Flux
citizen.learned: Caspian learned to read the tides from his father, a fisherman who knew the sea's moods.
citizen.lifestyle: Caspian spends his days studying the ebb and flow of the tides, recording his observations in a worn leather journal.
citizen.currently: Caspian is concerned about the recent changes in the tidal patterns and is determined to understand their cause.

relationships: Caspian and Sable often compare notes on their tidal observations.
Caspian and Orion have been friends since childhood and often fish together.
Caspian respects Emmet's knowledge of the sea and often seeks his advice.
